XData.name: DTL
XData.Data: <transform sourceClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' targetClass='EnsLib.HL7.Message' sourceDocType='AdtLegacy:LegacyAdt' targetDocType='AdtLegacy:LegacyAdt' create='new' language='objectscript' > <annotation>DTL for Adt from Legacy Adt</annotation> <assign value='source.{MSH}' property='target.{MSH}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{PID}' property='target.{PID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{EVN}' property='target.{EVN}' action='set' /> <assign value='"CATO"' property='target.{MSH:ReceivingApplication.namespaceID}' action='set' /> <assign value='source.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' property='eventType' action='set' /> <if condition='eventType="A30"' > <true> <assign value='"A40"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> <assign value='"A40"' property='target.{EVN:EventTypeCode}' action='set' /> </true> <false> <if condition='eventType="A44"' > <true> <assign value='"A45"' property='target.{EVN:EventTypeCode}' action='set' /> <assign value='"A45"' property='target.{MSH:MessageType.triggerevent}' action='set' /> </true> </if> </false> </if> <if condition='source.{PD1}'=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{PD1}' property='target.{PD1}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <if condition='source.{MRG}'=""' > <true> <assign value='source.{MRG}' property='target.{MRG}' action='set' /> </true> </if> <assign value='source.{PV1}' property='target.{PV1}' action='set' /> <foreach property='source.{DG1()}' key='k1' > <assign value='source.{DG1(k1)}' property='target.{DG1(k1)}' action='set' /> </foreach> </transform>
